title: Adaptive AIRA planning, bounded delegation and independent outcome verification
whatBuilt: DURABLE TYPED PLAN: steps TYPED (tool|delegation|approval|artifact) with explicit bounds (deadlineMs/maxRetries/maxStepCostUsd); append-only events; CHECKPOINT replays into an identical state across a context reset (proven by equality); callables never serialize (named verifier registry re-bound on restore — part of the plan definition)
BOUNDED DELEGATION: delegation steps REQUIRE a registered independent verifier at add-time; retries and cumulative cost budgets enforced — exceeding either fails the step CLOSED (no infinite retry)

INDEPENDENT OUTCOME VERIFICATION: a delegate's self-reported success is NEVER completion; completion requires the INDEPENDENT executable check to pass (failed checks fail the step); verification is backend-authorized
NO DUPLICATE OR LATE EFFECTS: step effects idempotent by stepId+revision; effects against a superseded plan revision refused
APPROVAL STEPS: explicit approver required; the model can neither approve nor self-approve
ADAPTIVE REPLANNING: constraint changes create a new plan revision with refreshed bounds; replanning backend-authorized

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 197/197 pass (186 previous + 11 planning)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The planner is the CONTRACT plane; wiring to the real AIRA/run adapters and hosted execution remains integration work. No educational-gain claim is made. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
